items.text: NPR, Fox News, GlobalSecurity.org Day 99 OPREP (June 5-6): Iran's IRGC fired seven ballistic missiles toward Kuwait and Bahrain on Friday evening. CENTCOM intercepted six; the seventh failed to reach its target. CENTCOM also shot down four Iranian attack drones headed toward the Strait of Hormuz. In response, US forces struck Iranian coastal surveillance radar sites at Goruk and on Qeshm Island. Trump said Iran still had '21-22% of their missiles remaining.' The exchange 'further frayed' an already shaky ceasefire (NPR). Iran navy claimed 'warning shots' at US warships in Gulf of Oman — CENTCOM denied. Day 99 marks continued ESCALATION phase with missiles + drones exchanged multiple times within one week. ACLED: Iran continued targeting the Gulf while a US agreement stalls (updated June 6).

items.text: Gulf News, Reuters (June 5-6): Petroleum Development Oman confirmed operations at Mina al Fahal export terminal were briefly disrupted by an explosion before resuming. The terminal handles Oman's key crude exports via the Gulf of Oman — a reminder that war disruption extends beyond Hormuz itself. Bahrain condemned the June 5 missile attack and demanded that Iran 'fully open the Strait without restrictions, disclose its naval-mine locations, and allow more than 20,000 stranded sailors to leave safely,' adding its 'patience does not imply weakness.' Kuwait's army stated explosions were from air-defense interceptions. GlobalSecurity.org confirmed: 108 commercial vessels redirected by CENTCOM, blockade continues operating. No de-mining has begun.

items.text: Britannica live, CNN (June 4-5): Hezbollah rejected the latest US-brokered ceasefire agreement on June 4 as Israeli strikes killed 4 people in Lebanon. Iran's FM Abbas Araghchi said the war will only end 'when it also ends in Lebanon,' explicitly linking any Hormuz/Iran deal to a full Lebanon settlement including Israeli troop withdrawal. assessment.body:
Sunday 8:45 AM IST. Day 99. War's third month. Four signals heading into Week 15.

IRAN MISSILES — JUNE 5 (AFTER SESSION CLOSE)
7 ballistic missiles at Kuwait + Bahrain. CENTCOM intercepted 6. 7th failed.
US struck Goruk + Qeshm radar sites in response.
Iran navy: 'warning shots' at US warships in Gulf of Oman — CENTCOM denied.
Trump: Iran has 21-22% of missiles remaining.
This was not intercepted by India's market session on Friday.
GIFT Nifty at 2:30AM IST June 6: 23,091 (-1.86%) — the market's verdict.
Monday June 9: sharp gap-down open expected.

OMAN MINA AL FAHAL TERMINAL
Explosion near SBM berths June 5 — briefly disrupted, then resumed.
Oman is Iran's backchannel mediator. Even the mediator's oil infrastructure is now hit.
Bahrain: demanded Iran disclose mine locations + free 20,000+ sailors.

THE LEBANON LINKAGE — THE BIGGEST NEW DEVELOPMENT
Iran FM Araghchi: 'The war will only end when it also ends in Lebanon.'
This is the deal-blocking condition.
Hezbollah rejected US-brokered ceasefire on June 4.
Israel killed 4 in Lebanon. Israeli forces across the Litani.
Lebanese President Aoun: Iran using Lebanon as 'bargaining chip.'
Iran cannot sign a Hormuz MOU while Hezbollah is fighting — politically impossible.
Deal timeline: mid-to-late June at earliest.

RBI STATUS QUO + 5-PRONGED FII PLAN
Repo rate: 5.25% — unanimous. Positive for growth support.
Governor Malhotra's 5-pronged plan: G-Sec tax relief, FCNR swap, dollar inflows.
FII sold Rs8,776 Cr June 5; DII bought Rs9,133 Cr — domestic institutions holding.
